content.text: Do you recommend this business?Review Highlights“Airport was very easy to get through, easy to get assistance and it was also pretty clean for an airport.” in 30 reviews“Terminal B opened in phases, from 2018 to completing it in July 2022, a month after Terminal C (Delta only).” in 179 reviews“Newly renovated LaGuardia Airport can officially boast as having one of the best new airport terminals in the world.” in 32 reviewsLocation & HoursMon4:00 AM - 11:00 PMTue4:00 AM - 11:00 PMWed4:00 AM - 11:00 PMThu4:00 AM - 11:00 PMFri4:00 AM - 11:00 PMClosed nowSat4:00 AM - 11:00 PMSun4:00 AM - 11:00 PMAmenities and MoreAccessible parking near entranceADA-compliant main entranceNo steps or stairsADA-compliant restroomAbout the BusinessBusiness owner informationPANYNJ w.ManagerLaGuardia Airport is a leading gateway for business and leisure travel. The airport is located in New York City's Borough of Queens, and is eight miles from midtown Manhattan. The airport consists of four terminals. In Terminal A (the historic Marine Air Terminal), Delta provides shuttle operations to Boston and Washington, D.C. Terminal B, the Central Terminal Building, is home to top U.S. and Canadian airlines including Air Canada, Air Tran, American Airlines, Frontier, JetBlue, Southwest, Spirit, and United. The 12-gate Terminal C provides passengers with service on US Airways and WestJet in the west concourse and Delta Air Lines in the east concourse. The 11-gate Terminal D accommodates service by Delta. LaGuardia is easily accessible from the Grand Central Parkway (Exit 7) and NYC Transit buses Q47, Q70 Limited and M60.Ask the CommunityQ:Can I take a non aerosol Barbasol shaving cream with 6 ounces at the airport?
